FunAsrNet.description: Pure C# Mandarin ASR and TTS. Version 1.0.1 publishes core and Vulkan NuGet packages, covering live transcription, 175 voices and telephone audio processing.
features: Core and Vulkan NuGet packages in 1.0.1, with CPU SIMD / GPU kernel improvements
Mandarin ASR, VAD, WebSocket previews and Chinese TTS
Fixed BF16 / FP32 weight expansion and telephone audio processing
FunAsrNet.note: The core targets .NET 10+. Prepare weights, lexicons and phoneme assets using the documentation. Supported configurations use fixed Fun-ASR, FSMN VAD and Chinese VITS models. Enable Vulkan explicitly through the library API with compatible drivers. The web example defaults to CPU.
FunAsrNet.overview: FunAsrNet 1.0.1 publishes core and Vulkan extension NuGet packages for Mandarin recognition, Chinese VITS synthesis, FSMN VAD and telephone audio on .NET 10+. CPU improvements cover SIMD feature extraction, FFT, RoPE, vocabulary scanning, FP32 blocked matrices and Q8 integer reductions. The Vulkan extension adds FP32 matrix pipelines, grouped projections and long-sequence attention. Tools expand supported BF16 / FP32 weights losslessly into FP32 GGUF, with C#, CLI, HTTP / WebSocket and browser examples.
scenarios: Explore Mandarin transcription and speech output in .NET apps
Experiment with browser microphones, WebSockets, and VAD segmentation
Work with PCM, G.711, and resampling in telephone-audio experiments
requirements: .NET 10 or later, with the SDK specified by global.json for source builds
Prepare and SHA-256 verify model weights, lexicons and phoneme assets
Optional Vulkan needs the matching extension, system loader and compatible drivers
steps: Install FunAsrNet 1.0.1 and prepare ASR / VAD or Chinese TTS models and assets.
Validate your audio with FunAsr.Transcribe or MandarinTts.Synthesize.
For GPU use, install FunAsrNet.Vulkan 1.0.1, set FloatBackend before inference and manage its lifetime.
Build the source service for WebSocket and browser demos, following model, queue and concurrency settings.

Detection-head fine-tuning, validation, early stopping, ONNX export and web labeling

GPU execution needs compatible drivers, and generic ONNX TopK defaults to CPU. Consult the 0.11.3 report for measured performance and numerical differences.
SimdYolo.overview: SimdYolo provides C# YOLO inference and detection-head fine-tuning for .NET 10, covering detection, segmentation and pose with supported PT / PTH, ONNX and SYTRAIN models. Version 0.11.3 improves CPU max-pooling boundaries, allocations in 2x nearest-neighbor resizing, and Vulkan concatenation uploads and copies. It retains model-loading and first-inference improvements. A unified API accepts RGB24 / BGR24 pixels, and the web example supports person / vehicle separation, background removal, labeling and fine-tuning.
scenarios: Explore detection, segmentation, and pose in .NET image applications
Study model loading and execution without a Python inference runtime
Experiment with labeling, pre-labeling, and supported detection-head fine-tuning

Supported weights from the model list, using Git LFS for source examples
Platform drivers for Vulkan / Metal and validation appropriate to your model and backend

Decode images to RGB24 / BGR24 and run YoloDetector.Predict, reusing the detector for successive frames.
Install SimdYolo.Training 0.11.3 for fine-tuning and prepare labels, validation data and configuration.

PureDb.eyebrow: Keep data close to your code
PureDb.description: A pure .NET 10 embedded database. Candidate 1.0.0-rc.1 covers KV, SQL, JSON, ADO.NET, transactions, snapshot backups and large-range access.
features: KV / SQL, composite indexes, CTEs, window functions and C# user functions
Transactions, savepoints, multi-threaded writes and consistent backups
rc.1 large-range access, checkpoint improvements and optional SQLite file compatibility
PureDb.note: 1.0.0-rc.1 is a release candidate. SQL and SQLite file compatibility have explicit limits; full SQLite SQL and the WAL file protocol are not supported. Assess performance, memory and production suitability with your own workload.
PureDb.overview: PureDb implements an embedded file database with C# and the .NET 10 standard library. Neither its core nor its optional SQLite file-compatibility package needs third-party NuGet or native libraries. Candidate 1.0.0-rc.1 provides KV, SQL, JOINs, JSON, composite indexes, foreign keys, CTEs, window functions, transactions and ADO.NET. This update focuses on large primary-key ranges, checkpoint memory reclamation, range mutations and consistent backups. Consult the SQL support list and candidate reports for limits and measured results.
scenarios: Explore embedded storage for local tools and desktop apps
Query structured and JSON data through SQL or ADO.NET
Study managed database internals, transactions, and file compatibility
requirements: A .NET 10 development environment
Check SQL, transaction and concurrency boundaries for candidate 1.0.0-rc.1
Review file-compatibility limits and back up SQLite files before use
steps: Install PureDb 1.0.0-rc.1; KV and SQL APIs use separate files.
Start with parameterized queries and transactions, then explore C# user functions and backups.
Use the same version for SQLite compatibility and evaluate scale, recovery and memory using the rc.1 reports.

SimdSkia.description: A C# 2D renderer. Version 0.1.4 supports Avalonia desktops and Android CPU rendering, with Direct2D, Vulkan, SIMD and image generation.
features: Stable 0.1.4 with Avalonia desktop and Android CPU / SIMD integration
Direct2D preferred on Windows and Vulkan on Linux, with CPU fallback
SKCanvas image generation, PDF page rendering and desktop NativeAOT
SimdSkia.note: Desktop validation covers Avalonia 12.1.0–12.1.5. Android examples use 12.1.5 and net10.0-android36.0. macOS and Android use CPU rendering. Recompile code using SK* types and assess third-party controls, fonts and rendering compatibility when migrating.
SimdSkia.overview: SimdSkia implements 2D drawing, fonts, basic layout and image codecs in C#. Use SKCanvas to generate PNG images or integrate with Avalonia while retaining XAML and view models. Stable 0.1.4 adds Android NuGet integration. The desktop entry point prefers Direct2D on Windows and hardware Vulkan on Linux X11 / XWayland, with CPU fallback and explicit CPU selection. macOS and Android render on the CPU. Desktop applications can publish with their target platform NativeAOT toolchain. Current main-branch work on the 0.1.4 codebase further optimizes runtime-effect execution plans, mesh / texture sampling, Avalonia scope records and font caches. See the November 10 second-round report for source changes and measurements.
scenarios: Generate PNG images with SKCanvas in services or console apps
Evaluate CPU, Direct2D and Vulkan backends in Avalonia desktop applications
Integrate CPU / SIMD rendering on Avalonia Android or render PDF pages as images
requirements: .NET 10 applications and SDK 10.0.403 or a compatible version specified by global.json for source builds
Align directly referenced SimdSkia.* packages to 0.1.4 and keep Avalonia packages on one verified version
Android uses net10.0-android36.0 and Avalonia 12.1.5, with Activity themes and fonts configured as documented
steps: Choose SimdSkia, SimdSkia.Avalonia.Desktop or SimdSkia.Avalonia.Android 0.1.4 for your application.
Follow the migration guide to configure UseSimdSkiaDesktop() or UseSimdSkiaAndroid().
Use options.UseCpu() for explicit CPU rendering and validate real windows for fonts, output quality and performance.

Chunked resumable transfers, multi-directory sync, and auditing

Transfers support resumable chunks; desktop clients handle multiple servers and directories, while Android provides file and photo workflows. Web and Android clients view existing GLB models. Android 1.4.0 provides a project camera, watermarks and gallery interactions, with server and client downloads under v2.7.0.

Explore multi-directory synchronization across desktop platforms
Manage engineering photos and files with the Android client

p2pvpn.description: An independent virtual-network project with a user console, network and device groups, P2P traversal, Windows/Linux clients and separate WSS relays.

P2P direct connections with optional WSS relays
Windows and Linux clients, plus Android source

Users manage networks, groups, and devices, with clients preferring direct connections. The control service coordinates accounts and connectivity; relaying depends on deployed online infrastructure.

Arithmetic.description: A pure managed precision library. Version 2.0.0 offers BigInt, BigRational and BigFloat, plus fixed-width Float128, DoubleDouble and QuadDouble.
features: BigInt, BigRational and correctly rounded arbitrary-precision BigFloat
New fixed-width Float128, DoubleDouble and QuadDouble types
Generic math, RoundingMode and conversions between numerical types
Arithmetic.note: 2.0.0 renames Real to BigFloat and RealRounding to RoundingMode. Float128 provides correct rounding, while DoubleDouble / QuadDouble target fast calculations at roughly 106 / 212 bits. Select types using their documented precision and error bounds.
Arithmetic.overview: Sdcb.Arithmetic 2.0.0 provides arbitrary-precision BigInt, BigRational and BigFloat alongside allocation-free fixed-width Float128, DoubleDouble and QuadDouble. Float128 implements IEEE 754 binary128 with 113-bit precision and correct rounding. DoubleDouble and QuadDouble target fast calculations at roughly 106 and 212 bits. This release renames Real / RealRounding to BigFloat / RoundingMode, and adds conversions and generic-math integration.

Use arbitrary-precision types in generic-math code

SimdCodecs.description: Pure managed .NET image codecs. Version 2.0.0 adds the unified ImageCodecs API, pixel buffers, orientation handling and multi-frame processing, with SIMD and NativeAOT.
features: Unified ImageCodecs APIs in 2.0.0 for multiple formats and frames
PixelBuffer, explicit pixel layouts, EXIF orientation and metadata propagation
SIMD / NativeAOT, 16-bit output and optional HEIF / HEIC decoding
SimdCodecs.note: Upgrade 1.x callers using the migration guide for ImageCodecs and PixelFormat, and dispose IDisposable images. Format capabilities depend on the encoder and decoder. HEIF / HEIC requires a separately installed and registered extension and assessment of HEVC patent obligations.
SimdCodecs.overview: Maintained by sdcb, SimdCodecs supplies managed .NET 10 image codecs. Stable 2.0.0 unifies encoding and decoding under ImageCodecs, with pixel layout selection, regions, scaling and EXIF orientation handling. PixelBuffer manages pixels and metadata. Formats include JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF, GIF, BMP, ICO, QOI and Netpbm, with JPEG 2000 / JBIG2 decoding and an optional HEIF / HEIC extension. It supports frame readers, 16-bit samples, SIMD and NativeAOT.
scenarios: Build image-loading, conversion and thumbnail workflows in .NET services
Provide RGB / BGRA / grayscale buffers to OCR, computer vision or desktop rendering
Evaluate managed decoding in NativeAOT or WebAssembly environments

Check encoding, decoding, bit-depth and animation support per format, with hardware-selected SIMD and scalar fallback
Install Sdcb.SimdCodecs.Heif and call ImageCodecs.Register for HEIF / HEIC
steps: Install Sdcb.SimdCodecs 2.0.0 and inspect headers with ImageCodecs.TryReadInfo.
Use ImageCodecs.Decode(data, PixelFormat.Rgba32, options) to obtain a PixelBuffer and dispose it with using.
Use TryDecodeInto for caller-owned buffers, pass layout, stride and metadata when encoding, and follow the migration table for 1.x callers.

SimdFace.eyebrow: Connect faces and features with C#
SimdFace.description: Local .NET 10 face detection and 1:1 verification using YuNet, SFace and 128-dimensional features, with CPU SIMD, Vulkan and browser WASM execution.
features: YuNet boxes, confidence and five landmarks, with 128-dimensional SFace features
1:1 photo verification, feature JSON export and vector comparison
CPU SIMD, Vulkan and browser WASM, with CLI and web interfaces
SimdFace.note: Core package 1.0.0 accepts contiguous RGB24 pixels. Build image decoding, CLI and web examples from source. The repository includes fixed YuNet / SFace weights, with a verification script to restore missing or damaged files. Compare features from matching models and extraction pipelines, and calibrate thresholds for your samples.
SimdFace.overview: SimdFace provides local face detection and 1:1 verification for .NET 10. YuNet locates faces and five landmarks, while SFace extracts normalized 128-dimensional features from aligned faces. The project offers C# CPU SIMD inference, a Vulkan backend and an official .NET WASM AOT browser build. A unified web interface switches execution modes, with C#, CLI and HTTP API integration also available. Managed image decoding handles JPEG, PNG, WebP and EXIF orientation. Exported feature JSON identifies its model and extraction pipeline.
scenarios: Detect faces, annotate landmarks and extract features in .NET applications
Compare two single-person photos or vectors exported by the same pipeline
Evaluate browser WASM, backend CPU and Vulkan execution in a unified web interface
requirements: .NET 10 SDK and PowerShell 7, with bundled fixed YuNet / SFace weights verified by the script
64-bit Windows / Linux with compatible Vulkan loader and drivers for the GPU backend
wasm-tools for the official browser AOT build, deploying models and _framework resources together
steps: Install SimdFace 1.0.0 for core inference, or clone the source for image decoding, CLI and web examples.
Verify the bundled weights with Get-Models.ps1, run dotnet restore --locked-mode, then build in Release mode.
Run src/SimdFace.Web for the web interface, or use detect / compare in src/SimdFace.Cli.
For C# integration, supply contiguous RGB24 pixels to FaceDetector and FaceRecognizer and calibrate verification thresholds.
